purpose: Define reverse traceability so a canonical semantic node can be traced back to Topics, owners, consumers, relations, projections and authoritative definitions.

topics.name: Reverse Trace Contract
topics.purpose: Define reverse traceability so a canonical semantic node can be traced back to Topics, owners, consumers, relations, projections and authoritative definitions.

semantics.reverse_rule: Machine-significant forward references used for architecture/composition have reconstructable reverse trace.
semantics.owner_trace: Semantic fact -> authoritative owner/definition is resolvable.
semantics.topic_trace: Node -> direct/inherited/composed Topic context is resolvable.
semantics.consumer_trace: Owned substrate semantic -> composing Domains/MetaModules/projections can be enumerated where indexed.
semantics.relation_trace: Relation instance/use -> relation definition -> owner is resolvable.
semantics.projection_trace: Projection output -> source semantics and projection definition is resolvable.

invariants.rule: A generic reader can resolve canonical identity, Topic context, references and semantic ownership without filesystem or prose heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: semantic fact cannot resolve authoritative owner
architecture composition is forward-only where reverse trace is required

references.purpose: Reverse trace complements forward recursive reading.
Relations are discoverable through explicit registry.

prose.summary: Define reverse traceability so a canonical semantic node can be traced back to Topics, owners, consumers, relations, projections and authoritative definitions.
